name: read-along
description: Listen to Claude's replies while the sentence being read is highlighted. Local voices (Kokoro, or your system's own), several languages, auto-read, and a player above the prompt.

englishVoice.title: English voice
englishVoice.description: Default English voice. A Kokoro voice (af_heart) or a Windows voice as win:<name> (win:Microsoft Ava Native).

englishVoices.title: English voices
englishVoices.description: Comma-separated English voices: the message voice button steps through these, and the settings pane lists them.
englishVoices.default: af_heart,am_fenrir,bf_emma,win:Microsoft Ava Native,win:Microsoft Aria Native,win:Microsoft Eric Native

japaneseVoice.title: Japanese voice
japaneseVoice.description: Default voice for Japanese sentences. A Kokoro voice (af_heart) or a Windows voice as win:<name> (win:Microsoft Ava Native).

japaneseVoices.title: Japanese voices
japaneseVoices.description: Comma-separated Japanese voices the settings pane offers.

hebrewVoice.title: Hebrew voice
hebrewVoice.description: Default voice for Hebrew sentences (Kokoro has no Hebrew).

hebrewVoices.title: Hebrew voices
hebrewVoices.description: Comma-separated Hebrew voices the settings pane offers.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Playback speed, 0.5 to 4. Speech is made at normal speed and sped up without changing pitch.

duckOthers.title: Lower other apps while reading
duckOthers.description: Turns other Windows apps (music, a browser) down to this share of their own volume while a read plays, and back up when it stops. WSL's own audio is left alone.

autoReadReplies.title: Auto-read Claude's replies
autoReadReplies.description: off; final reads each turn's final reply; all reads every text block as it arrives.

highlightColor.title: Highlight colour
highlightColor.description: Background behind the sentence being read: a hex colour or a colour name.

highlightTextColor.title: Highlight text colour
highlightTextColor.description: Text colour of the sentence being read.

readCode.title: Read code blocks
readCode.description: Off says "code block" in place of each fenced block.

buttons.title: Message buttons
buttons.description: hover shows a message's buttons at its top-right while the pointer is anywhere on it (they can flash as messages scroll under a resting pointer); glyph shows them only while the pointer is on the ♪ at its right; always shows them under every message; off hides them.

controls.title: Controls while reading
controls.description: Where a read's progress and controls show: bottom (the bottom player), message (under the message being read), or both.

bottom.title: Bottom player
bottom.description: band: a one-row player above the prompt, always there so nothing jumps; hint: progress as dim text on the hint line under the prompt, no extra row (control from the message buttons or /read-along).

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: nerd: Nerd Font speaker/pause icons in the player (WezTerm draws them from JetBrainsMono Nerd Font); text: plain symbols for terminals without a Nerd Font.

python.title: Python for the speech service
python.description: A Python with kokoro, torch and soundfile installed.
